scope: Picture tests of 2026-10-22 on MedicineBow (one NVIDIA RTX A6000 per job): four Qwen models on the 308 requests of picture-test-20261021; random-window sets of saved PODFoam states (start-up states, three window seeds; a developed flow) for up to eleven models; and the two pimpleFoam runs whose states they use. No solver run in these jobs.
notes: Sources are paths inside the archives named in 'archives'. picture-test-24757327 and the window-test archives except 24757459 are in the picture-test-2026-10-22 release with the two input archives; window-test-24757459.tar.gz and developed-window-test-20261022.tar.gz are added there; developed-flow-20261022.tar.gz is in the pod-insitu-v2-2026-10-22 release.
Files of kind gzip copy are gzip -9 copies (no name, mtime 0) of the named source; source_sha256 is the hash of the uncompressed bytes.

runtime/<job>/server/<model>.* are the server's stamped files (server/server-<stamp>.*); the archives also hold a copy of each log named by model, taken before the server stopped, which the stamped log extends.
Window jobs also wrote summary.json files with 0 attempted requests for the 308-request sets they did not run; those are left out.
pictures/ holds PNG bytes decoded from the base64 image_url of the named request body.
truth.private.json means withheld from model input, not private personal information.
Original records contain cluster paths and server PIDs as provenance.
